// Offline synthetic fixture, not a live build or acceptance receipt.
// The official v0.31.2 producer copies frontend res.Metadata to
// record.ExporterResponse and image exporter descriptors to Result.Results.
// MarshalVT/UnmarshalVT reproduce the queue's actual persistence serialization.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"time"

	controlapi "github.com/moby/buildkit/api/services/control"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/timestamppb"
)

func main() {
	record := &controlapi.BuildHistoryRecord{
		Ref: "serialized-solve-ref",
		Exporters: []*controlapi.Exporter{{
			Type: "image", Attrs: map[string]string{
				"name": "fixture.invalid/image:owned", "push": "true",
			},
		}},
		CreatedAt: timestamppb.New(time.Unix(1791511200, 123456789)),
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	if err := enc.Encode(&controlapi.BuildHistoryEvent{Record: record.CloneVT()}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	record.CompletedAt = timestamppb.New(time.Unix(1791511202, 987654321))
	metadata := map[string][]byte{
		"containerimage.config": []byte(`{"architecture":"amd64"}`),
	}
	record.ExporterResponse = map[string]string{}
	for key, value := range metadata {
		record.ExporterResponse[key] = string(value)
	}
	descriptor := &controlapi.Descriptor{
		Digest:    "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		MediaType: "application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json", Size: 512,
	}
	record.Result = &controlapi.BuildResultInfo{
		ResultDeprecated: descriptor,
		Results:          map[int64]*controlapi.Descriptor{0: descriptor},
		Attestations: []*controlapi.Descriptor{{
			Digest:    "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
			MediaType: "application/vnd.in-toto+json", Size: 128,
		}},
	}
	raw, err := record.MarshalVT()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var persisted controlapi.BuildHistoryRecord
	if err := persisted.UnmarshalVT(raw); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := enc.Encode(&controlapi.BuildHistoryEvent{
		Type: controlapi.BuildHistoryEventType_COMPLETE, Record: &persisted,
	}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
